drug_class: Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR) Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly reduces gefitinib plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; discontinue at least 2 weeks before gefitinib initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Extract/Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases gefitinib bioavailability and risk of toxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; may elevate drug levels unpredictably

avoid_supplements.name: High-Dose Vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potential antiplatelet effects may increase bleeding risk in patients with thrombocytopenia
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to <400 IU daily; monitor for bleeding signs

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce gefitinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor efficacy; counsel on potential interaction

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive antiplatelet effects; generally safe at standard doses
caution_supplements.action: Acceptable at normal dietary doses; inform oncology team

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases gefitinib plasma concentration and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; counsel patient on all grapefruit products

avoid_foods.name: Seville Oranges and Pomelo
avoid_foods.mechanism: Similar furanocoumarins to grapefruit inhibit CYP3A4
avoid_foods.action: Avoid; suggest alternative citrus fruits (sweet oranges, lemons acceptable)

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase gefitinib absorption; dosing typically accounts for food effects but fat timing varies response
caution_foods.action: Consistent meal pattern recommended; take with or without food consistently

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous Vegetables (broccoli, cabbage, Brussels sprouts)
caution_foods.mechanism: Contains glucosinolates with mild CYP1A2 induction; effect on CYP3A4 minimal
caution_foods.action: No restriction needed; encourage as part of balanced diet

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of gefitinib toxicity (diarrhea, skin rash, hepatotoxicity) especially if CYP3A4 inhibitors are introduced. Counsel patients to maintain consistent meal timing and absolutely avoid grapefruit; report all herbal supplements and over-the-counter medications to oncology team.
